title: Follow macOS light and dark appearance
description: DayBar currently remains visually light when the macOS appearance changes. Add deterministic system-appearance resolution and synchronize the AppKit floating panel plus its hosted SwiftUI hierarchy with NSApp.effectiveAppearance.
design: Use a testable SystemAppearancePolicy in DayBarCore and a private KVO-backed coordinator in the app target. Keep semantic SwiftUI colors and the popover material; add no user preference or dependency.

title: Guard against backward schema migration when switching branches
description: Adding animalsJSON to GardenMeta on feat/roaming-farm-window changes the SwiftData schema. Running the farm build migrates the live store forward; running a main build afterwards asks Core Data to migrate BACKWARD, which it cannot infer. The user's store accumulated 11 schemamigrator entries and ended up corrupt (malformed schema page: indexes referencing a non-existent ATRANSACTION table), which bricked the app via fatalError. The fatalError is now fixed (quarantine + fresh store + sticky notice). Remaining work: make schema changes safe across branch switches - e.g. a per-schema-version store filename, or a documented 'back up before switching branches' step, or an explicit VersionedSchema + MigrationPlan instead of relying on inferred lightweight migration.
acceptance_criteria: Switching between branches with different GardenMeta schemas cannot corrupt or lose the live store

title: Garden v2.1: make the farm actually playable
description: User feedback after shipping the roaming farm window: 'game sucks, nothing to do, super weird, land for planting is barely visible, I open it and don't know what it is for'. Root causes found in code: (1) map is 24x16=384 tiles but content is only 3 plots + 1 locked slot; (2) default GardenActionMode is .automatic so clicking a plot shows an alert popup instead of doing anything; (3) zero animals until bought, so the entire right half across the river is empty pens; (4) plots are 3 scattered 1-tile soil squares, do not read as farmland; (5) zero decoration sprites exist in the manifest, so ~370 tiles are identical grass; (6) no hover/cursor/label affordance; (7) nothing animates except one sparkle fade; (8) the core verb (focus) lives in the menu bar, so the window is a passive trophy case.
